name: Book
description: Core entity representing books in the library catalog with details and real-time availability tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the book record

fields.name: isbn
fields.description: International Standard Book Number for unique book identification

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the book

fields.name: author
fields.description: Author name(s) of the book

fields.name: category
fields.description: Book category or genre classification

fields.name: totalCopies
fields.description: Total number of copies owned by the library

fields.name: availableCopies
fields.description: Number of copies currently available for checkout

fields.name: location
fields.description: Physical location or shelf number in the library

constraints.availableCopies: Must be less than or equal to totalCopies
constraints.isbn: Must be unique across all books

name: Member
description: Library member with personal details, membership status, and borrowing privileges

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the member

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Member's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Member's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Member's email address for communication

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Member's contact phone number

fields.name: membershipType
fields.description: Type of membership (e.g., Standard, Premium, Student)

fields.name: membershipStatus
fields.description: Current status of membership (Active, Expired, Suspended)

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when membership expires

email.message: Must be a valid email address

membershipStatus.message: Status must be Active, Expired, or Suspended

membershipType.message: Type must be Standard, Premium, or Student

name: MembershipType
description: Lookup entity defining membership tiers with borrowing privileges, loan duration, and fee structure

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the membership type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the membership tier (e.g., Basic, Premium, Student)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of membership benefits and features

fields.name: maxBooksAllowed
fields.description: Maximum number of books that can be borrowed simultaneously

fields.name: loanDurationDays
fields.description: Default loan period in days for borrowed books

fields.name: renewalLimit
fields.description: Maximum number of times a loan can be renewed

fields.name: annualFee
fields.description: Annual membership fee amount

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this membership type is currently available for registration

constraints.renewalLimit: Must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.annualFee: Must be greater than or equal to 0

name: Category
description: Lookup entity for book categories enabling classification and filtered searching

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Category name (e.g., Fiction, Science, History)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the category

fields.name: parentCategoryId
fields.description: Reference to parent category for hierarchical organization

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the category is currently active and available for use

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the category was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated

relationships.description: A category can be assigned to multiple books

name: Notification
description: Tracks all system notifications sent to members and librarians including delivery status and history

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (overdue_reminder, reservation_ready, due_soon, etc.)

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: ID of the member or librarian receiving the notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address where notification was sent

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Subject line of the notification

fields.name: message
fields.description: Full content/body of the notification message

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, failed, delivered)

fields.name: sentDate
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent

relationships.description: Links notification to the recipient member

name: Transaction
description: Records book borrowing transactions including checkout, due dates, returns, and fines

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the transaction

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the borrowed book

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member borrowing the book

fields.name: checkoutDate
fields.description: Date when the book was checked out

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date when the book is due for return

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Actual date when the book was returned

fields.name: status
fields.description: Transaction status: checked_out, returned, overdue

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Fine amount for overdue or damaged books

relationships.description: Each transaction is associated with one book
Each transaction is associated with one member

name: Reservation
description: Tracks book reservation requests from members when books are unavailable, managing reservation queue and fulfillment

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the reservation

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the reserved book

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member making the reservation

fields.name: reservationDate
fields.description: Date when the reservation was created

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when the reservation expires if not fulfilled

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of reservation (pending, notified, fulfilled, expired, cancelled)

fields.name: notificationSent
fields.description: Indicates if member was notified when book became available

fields.name: fulfilledDate
fields.description: Date when the reservation was fulfilled

relationships.description: Each reservation is for one book
Each reservation belongs to one member

indexes.name: idx_book_status
indexes.description: Optimize queries for active reservations by book

indexes.name: idx_member_status
indexes.description: Optimize queries for member's active reservations

indexes.name: idx_status_reservation_date
indexes.description: Support queue ordering for pending reservations

name: Fine
description: Entity managing financial penalties for overdue books including fine calculation, payment tracking, and waiver management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the fine record

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: Reference to the transaction that incurred the fine

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who owes the fine

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Fine amount in currency units

fields.name: fineDate
fields.description: Date when the fine was assessed

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Current payment status (pending, paid, waived, partial)

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date when the fine was paid or waived

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method used for payment (cash, card, online, waived)

relationships.description: Fine is associated with a specific transaction
Fine is owed by a specific member

indexes.name: idx_member_payment_status
indexes.description: Optimize queries for member's outstanding fines

indexes.name: idx_transaction
indexes.description: Quick lookup of fines by transaction

constraints.paymentStatus: Must be one of: pending, paid, waived, partial
constraints.paymentDate: Required when paymentStatus is paid or waived
